bullets.title: Small Asian bounce
bullets.text: Kitco shows gold at 3,888.40-3,890.40 at 03:02 SAST, up 12 dollars (+0.31%) after Thursday's fall.

bullets.title: Thursday's big drop
bullets.text: Gold closed Thursday near 3,877.84, down 2.76%, after a low of about 3,852 (KuCoin/FXStreet copy).

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index closed Thursday at 103.17, its highest in about 19 months (KuCoin/FXStreet copy).

bullets.title: Yields jumped
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield rose to 5.113% and the 2-year to 4.867% on Thursday, which weighs on gold.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch figures quoted put a December quarter-point hike near 85%, with half-point odds near 15%.

bullets.title: PPI is today
bullets.text: October PPI comes out today, and a hot number after Tuesday's hot CPI could push gold lower again.
